name: Paris & Île-de-France
text: Investments in Mistral AI, Doctolib, Pigment, AMI Labs, Alice & Bob, Gradium, Entalpic; Scaleway's H100 cluster; NVIDIA Ltd sales office in Courbevoie; Élysée meetings.

name: Saclay / Orsay
text: Jean Zay and Dalia supercomputers at CNRS-IDRIS (NVIDIA H100, A100, V100, GB200).

name: Bruyères-le-Châtel
text: First Mistral Compute deployment, 18,000 Grace Blackwell chips.

name: Fouju (Seine-et-Marne)
text: Campus IA, the joint venture of NVIDIA, MGX, Bpifrance and Mistral AI; 1.4 GW planned.

name: Biot (Sophia Antipolis)
text: NVIDIA Développement France: R&D subsidiary, 50–99 staff, €27M revenue (2024).

name: Grenoble
text: HPE × NVIDIA AI Factory Lab; Scintil Photonics (NVIDIA-backed); STMicroelectronics in EdgeAI-Trust.

name: Reims
text: First French NVIDIA CUDA Research Center (2015) and the C2I2 supercomputing chair (2017–2020).

name: Lyon
text: École Centrale de Lyon: MicrocombSys EU project and co-authored graphics research.

name: Bordeaux
text: Pollen Robotics, joining NVIDIA via the Hugging Face deal; Inria Bordeaux co-authored HPC research.

name: Pau
text: TotalEnergies' Pangea 5 supercomputer, built with Dell and NVIDIA.

name: Angers
text: Bull assembles NVIDIA Vera Rubin racks for Europe.

name: Nice
text: Inria Côte d'Azur (graphics research with NVIDIA); EURECOM in Sophia Antipolis (6G EU projects).

name: Rennes
text: INSA Rennes and Inria Rennes: Rising STARS EU project and co-authored papers.

name: Toulouse
text: CALMIP's Turpan supercomputer (Arm + NVIDIA) and co-authored research.

name: Brest (Ifremer)
text: Ifremer bought an NVIDIA DGX A100 for €274,191 (2021).
